messages:
alex: Quick proposal — can we tighten postmortem follow-ups? Thinking: 1) 30/60/90 day remediation checkpoints, 2) single owner per action with SLA, 3) lightweight weekly remediation digest to surface overdue items, 4) rotate ICs + add a 'remediation shepherd' role for continuous ownership. Thoughts?

priya: +1 on 30/60/90. How do you want to track ownership? our current board mixes actions with tasks so things fall through.

jordan: we could add a dedicated 'Remediations' lane on the incident board and require a small template for each item: owner, due_ts, recurrence_flag. Example template: 
```
- action: short phrase
- owner: @username
- due: yyyy-mm-dd
- severity: P1/P2
- recurrence: yes/no
- notes: link to postmortem section
```

marta: prefer storing due as epoch for easier sorting in dashboards. also include a 'last_update' field so we don't count stale items as active.

alex: agree on epoch. Also want automated reminders: 7d before due -> ping owner, 1d before -> ping owner+manager, and a weekly digest to #incidents with top overdue items.

sre-bot: Reminder rule created: type=remediation, lead_time=7d, notify=owner, cc=manager (automation id: rem-2026-11)

sam: for comms cadence: propose a short weekly thread in #incidents that lists open remediations >7d overdue, actions closed in the week, and recurring alerts to watch. Keep it 3 bullets max for exec consumption.

priya: :thumbsup: can Product Ops take the exec digest format so it's consistent with other reports?

jordan: also propose standardizing recurrence tags (infra, config, process, third_party) and a small recurrence_score = count_in_90d so we can surface patterns.

marta: thinking of a 3-field recurrence metric: count_in_90d, last_seen (epoch), pattern_tag. We can surface these in the dashboard and in the weekly digest.

alex: rotation details: ICs rotate weekly; new IC shadows the outgoing IC for first 72 hours for knowledge transfer. add a "remediation shepherd" for each 2-week sprint who is responsible for nudging owners and closing blockers.

sam: who will own rolling this out? eng-sre or oncall committee?

priya: I'll volunteer to pilot the remediation lane + automation for 6 weeks and report back. Will set up the board + template by Friday.

alex: great — action list for pilot: 
- priya: create remediation lane + template by Fri
- jordan: implement recurrence tags + dashboard query by Tue
- marta: add epoch due sorting + last_update field by Wed
- sam: draft comms cadence and weekly digest template by Thu
- alex: finalize rotation + shepherd policy and update oncall handbook by next Mon

sre-bot: Created tasks: https://redwood/tasks/2567 (remediation lane), https://redwood/tasks/2568 (recurrence tags), https://redwood/tasks/2569 (digest template)

marta: small note — include a field 'blocked_by' so external blockers are visible in the lane (vendor tickets, legal, infra rollouts).

priya: noted — adding 'blocked_by' and a short "blocking_eta" optional field.

alex: thanks all. We'll reconvene in one week to review the pilot metrics (open_count, avg_time_to_close, recurrence_score). :calendar:

sam: adding a lightweight alert that surfaces remediations that have been open >21 days and have recurrence_score >1. will link to dashboard.

jordan: can someone add a sample query we can reuse? I'll add an example in the board description.

priya: sample query: `project = INCIDENTS AND lane = Remediations AND due_epoch < now()+7d ORDER BY recurrence_score DESC` — will put in board notes.

alex: perfect. thanks everyone, excited to see this reduce repeated incidents and get remediation slippage down.
